new_episodes.source_paraphrase: During external security reconnaissance, Wiz found publicly reachable DeepSeek ClickHouse endpoints without authentication.
new_episodes.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Security discovery establishes an exposed route; it does not establish prior malicious use.

new_episodes.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Exposure, demonstrated access and potential further exploitation are distinct evidentiary propositions.
